shortDescription: NTA UGC NET June Re-Exam Notice 2026. Verify the latest notice on ugcnet.nta.ac.in before you apply, download or treat a result as final.
content:
National Testing Agency has issued an exam-city, schedule or admit-card related update for NTA UGC NET June Re-Exam Notice 2026.

Download the hall ticket or city intimation only from the official portal. Carry a printed copy and photo ID to the venue.

How to download

  1. Open ugcnet.nta.ac.in
  2. Use the Admit Card / Exam City login
  3. Enter registration number and password or date of birth
  4. Print the PDF and check shift, city and reporting time
